title: More Accurate or More Efficient? Evaluating Locally Deployed Compact Open-Weight Language Models for Mathematical Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2608.22048v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed on local hardware for privacy, cost, and accessibility reasons. Yet many evaluations emphasize accuracy while fewer quantify local runtime and energy, characterize failure modes, or apply paired statistical comparisons under controlled conditions. This paper presents a controlled, documented procedure for evaluating locally hosted LLMs on mathematical reasoning. It combines fixed inference settings, hierarchical answer extraction and verification, explicit failure-mode classification, and per-question resource measurement, and reports accuracy with paired significance tests and effect sizes. We demonstrate it in a preliminary study of three compact open-weight models under five billion parameters, Gemma3:4b (Google), Phi3:3.8b (Microsoft), and Qwen3:4b (Alibaba), across datasets spanning Grade 8 Math, Calculus I, and Advanced Probability and Statistics. translated_title: 更准确还是更高效？评估本地部署的紧凑型开源权重语言模型在数学推理中的表现
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.22048v1 公告类型：新 摘要：大型语言模型越来越多地部署在本地硬件上，出于隐私、成本和可访问性的原因。然而，许多评估强调准确性，而较少量化本地运行时间和能耗，描述失败模式，或在受控条件下应用配对统计比较。本文提出了一种受控、文档化的程序，用于评估本地托管的LLM在数学推理中的表现。它结合了固定推理设置、分层答案提取和验证、明确的失败模式分类以及每问题资源测量，并报告带有配对显著性检验和效应量的准确性。我们在对三个五亿参数以下的紧凑型开源权重模型（Gemma3:4b（谷歌）、Phi3:3.8b（微软）和Qwen3:4b（阿里巴巴））的初步研究中进行了演示，数据集涵盖八年级数学、微积分I和高级概率与统计。所有模型都通过相同的本地环境运行。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合固定推理设置、分层答案验证、失败模式分类和资源测量的受控评估程序，用于比较本地部署的紧凑型语言模型在数学推理中的准确性与效率，并通过配对统计检验揭示其性能差异。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a controlled evaluation procedure combining fixed inference settings, hierarchical answer validation, failure-mode classification, and resource measurement to compare accuracy and efficiency of locally deployed compact language models in mathematical reasoning, with paired statistical tests revealing performance differences.
